items.description: As Andy Burnham’s new government prepares to face scrutiny from MPs for the first time, Tom Fleming outlines ten key issues and questions facing parliament in the weeks and months ahead. items.title: Safeguarding the Constitution: Key Steps to Strengthen UK Democratic Resilience

items.title: Time to make lobbying more transparent
items.description: The Ethics and Integrity Commission has published a report on how to reform how lobbying of government is regulated, reported and monitored. items.title: Andy Burnham’s Number 10 should have fewer special advisers
items.description: Keir Starmer had 42 Special Advisers in Number 10. The expectation is that Andy Burnham will recruit a similar number.
